dataset_title: MONBIO 2.0 Flemish roadside grass area and annual dry-matter inventory (Table 27 extract)
source_title: Monitor van de Vlaamse bio-economie: update 2019-2020 (MONBIO 2.0), Eindrapport
source_location: Table 27, printed p. 91 / PDF p. 92; discussion printed pp. 89-90
material_scope: Reported roadside-grass inventory only; excludes the table's nature-grass and other-grass subtotals.
data_type: reported regional area and annual dry-matter estimates; mixed underlying source years and estimation methods
license_or_rights: No explicit open reuse license identified in the report or hosting page. Only a short, factual table extract is stored with attribution; do not redistribute the source PDF.
conversion_policy: No conversions or recalculation. Reported areas and dry-matter tonnes are preserved as printed. The total row area is intentionally blank because Table 27 does not print a roadside-area subtotal.
limitations: Historical Flemish regional inventory, not a GreenHub contracted catchment. The table combines different source years and methods (including wet-to-DM conversion, extrapolation, and a modeled railway estimate); its total is not a single-year measured delivery total. Area is not necessarily accessible or harvestable. No wet-mass basis, moisture by cut, parcel-level geometry, monthly supply, collection losses, or current contract records are reported. Reference-only; do not map to a Dutch default, seasonal schedule, or runtime parameter.
Underlying cited source years are 2008 or 2010, except the Infrabel modeled estimate. Report publication year 2023 is not the observation year.
citation: Van Kerckhove et al. (2023). Monitor van de Vlaamse bio-economie: update 2019-2020 (MONBIO 2.0), Eindrapport. Table 27. https://ilvo.vlaanderen.be/uploads/images/MONBIO2.0_rapport_FINAAL_2023-10-26-093333_wndy.pdf
